properties.name: booking.simulated-payments
properties.description: PROVISIONAL until step 9 (guide 20, part 5). Exposes POST /api/dev/bookings/{id}/payment-authorized, which simulates the card authorization. Never true in production.

properties.name: booking.jobs.enabled
properties.description: Turns on the scheduled jobs of every module: expired holds and unanswered requests (guide 21), cleanup of old access codes (guide 24). False switches them off, for example on a second instance of the application.

properties.name: auth.login-code.hmac-key
properties.description: SECRET (AUTH_CODE_HMAC_KEY). Base64 of at least 32 random bytes: the HMAC key of the access codes (guide 24, part 3). No default: without it the application does not start.

properties.name: notification.mail.from
properties.description: The sender of the emails of the system (MAIL_FROM). The real address of the studio comes before step 14.
